name: Settlement Data Rate 2
definition: Specifies the volume and value percentage rates of settlement instructions.

Volume.name: Volume
Volume.definition: Specifies the rate, in terms of volume, of the failed settlement instructions compared to the total volume, of settlement instructions performed (settled and failed) during the period covered by the report.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Specifies the rate, in terms of value, of the failed settlement instructions compared to the total value of settlement instructions performed (settled and failed) during the period covered by the report.
